response.rationale: The item is marked final_sale == True (intimates category). RET-012, the highest-priority rule (priority 100), makes final-sale items ineligible for return regardless of the standard 30-day window. Although the order is within 10 days of delivery, RET-007 (priority 10) is overridden by RET-012. The item is not defective, so RET-020 does not apply, and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is present.
